title: The Friendliest Witness
summary: River takes you to a Santo Domingo diner where a tip jar has gone missing and four witnesses have a story each.
description: A tip jar has gone missing from a Santo Domingo diner, and four witnesses sit at the counter with a story each. River asks V to come and question them with him.

start.bringUp: River has a small case at a Santo Domingo diner, a stolen tip jar and four witnesses. He wants V to come and question them with him.

variations.know: A dog's leash is on the diner floor with no dog attached, and the waitress says its owner ran out the back.
variations.wants: The owner found, with the story straight.

variations.know: A sandwich has gone missing from the counter, and each of the four witnesses has a different story about the plate.
variations.wants: The right name for the sandwich thief.

variations.know: V sets the case this time, and River plays the investigator at the diner counter.
variations.wants: V's case to be solved by River.

diner.name: the roadside diner on the main road through Santo Domingo

RWH2.inv.text: A diner in Santo Domingo. Four witnesses, one stolen tip jar. Come hungry and suspicious.

g1.asks: Who do you trust least in this room, and why is it the nicest one?
g1.know: You have heard the four statements. You know what each witness said about the tip jar and the waitress.
g1.secret: He knew who took the jar in the first minute.

stages.label: River and V question the diner witnesses
stages.objective: Question the four diner witnesses with River
stages.know: You are in the Santo Domingo diner with River. Four witnesses sit at the counter and each has given a statement about the stolen tip jar.
stages.wants: V to question the witnesses and name the thief.

right.memory: You named the friendliest of the four witnesses at the Santo Domingo diner, and River grudgingly said to keep it up.

wrong.memory: You named the wrong witness at the Santo Domingo diner, and River gave you a lesson about trusting the nicest one.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the Santo Domingo diner, and River questioned the four witnesses alone.
